VERITAS

GREEN • SMOKY • MAGNETIC

TOP NOTES: Cut Grass, Black Pepper, Rosemary
HEART NOTES: Jasmine, Roasted Chestnut, Woodsmoke
BASE NOTES: Charred Oak, Vanilla, Cedarwood

Fresh air with a dark side. Veritas brings the spirit of The Boondock Saints to crisp greens, cracked pepper, and smoke curling from charred wood. Roasted chestnut and vanilla soften the edges, giving this rugged scent a warmth that pulls you closer.

FRAGRANCE BREAKDOWN

products.title: Ameliore No. 1 - Leave in Conditioner by Kacie Margis
Lockhart’s Founder’s Reserve Premium Shave Soap
products.body_html:
A shave worth slowing down for.

We won’t be shy: our original Lockhart’s shave soap is good. Really good. It’s earned praise throughout the shaving community for its performance and rich lather. But our team wanted to push further. We didn’t just want to make one of the best—we wanted to make THE best.

That ambition meant premium ingredients, glass jar packaging, and nearly two years of development. We benchmarked against France’s Martin de Candre and Italy’s Saponificio Varesino, pushing ourselves to exceed the performance of soaps we’ve long admired.

Introducing Lockhart’s Founder’s Reserve Premium Shave Soap.

We’re shaving enthusiasts, and we believe this is one of the finest soaps we’ve ever developed: rich, creamy lather, incredibly slick glide, and a moisturizing, soothing post-shave feel. Its warm, woody, masculine fragrance balances fresh citrus with a subtle floral touch—an experience worth slowing down for.

Rich lather. Smooth glide. Post-shave comfort.

  • Dense, creamy cushion: Tallow and stearic acid build a rich lather for shaving.
  • Smooth razor glide: Lubricants and emollients help the razor move comfortably across the skin.  And, two advanced polymers make this soap incredibly slick with extreme glide.
  • Hydrated lather: Glycerin and sodium lactate help retain moisture throughout your shave.
  • Beard preparation: Hydrated lather helps soften beard hair for easier cutting.
  • A conditioned after-feel: Shea butter, avocado oil, and aloe contribute to soft, supple-feeling skin.
  • A traditional foundation, refined: A tallow-based soap enhanced with ingredients that support slip, texture, and skin feel.

The fragrance:

  • Opening: Bright bergamot and crisp grapefruit.
  • Heart: Soft rose with warm, creamy sandalwood.
  • Base: Earthy patchouli, dry cedarwood, and leather.
Overall character: A warm, woody, masculine fragrance balanced by fresh citrus and a subtle floral touch.


Your daily ritual:

  1. Wet your shaving brush and beard.
  2. Load the brush with soap and build a rich lather in a bowl or on your face, adding water gradually.
  3. Shave, rinse thoroughly, and enjoy the after-feel.

Slow down. Lather up. Make time for the ritual.

products.title: Fire & Brimstone Hell Froze Over Extreme Cooling Shave Soap
products.body_html:
Introducing, Fire & Brimstone Hell Froze Over shave soap.


We at Lockhart’s like a good challenge.  We were asked to participate in the annual Blizzard Battles (on the “A Texan Shaves” YouTube Channel) which determines the coldest shave soap on earth each year.  The competition is fierce, everything from fantastic up and coming brands like Adopted Acres to terrific long established brands like Stirling Soap.  Our shave soaps have received enormous industry recognition for their outstanding performance in the past few years, but we had never made a mentholated shave soap.

Challenge accepted.
 
Although we did not quite finish our development in time for the Blizzard Battles after more than a year of development we finally have what we think is the best cold soap on earth.  It’s an epic combination of a soap so cold it almost burns featuring an “icy” version of our iconic Fire & Brimstone scent along with industry leading performance.  The thick, rich lather, slick glide, and incredible post-shave feel rival the best soaps money can buy.  We actually managed to improve the performance of our already extremely popular standard line shave soaps.  It's that good!

You need to try this soap IF:

  • You chase the coldest shave you can possibly find (we’re not kidding either, it’s really fist pumping, nail biting cold!)
  • You love our iconic Fire & Brimstone scent, but an icier, cooler variant
  • You demand industry leading rich, creamy, high performing lathers
  • You love that extremely cool feeling on your face for 30 minutes (or more!) after you shave

products.title: Lockhart's Anti-Gravity Shave Soap
products.body_html:
Fortuna Anti-Gravity Scent

Top notes: Bergamot, Elemi, Sichuan Pepper, Lemon Verbena
Mid notes: Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Violet leaf, Green notes
Base notes: Patchouli, Ambroxan, Sandalwood, Ambergris

We love shaving here at Lockhart’s.  It’s the one self-care experience that men get to own as their own.  

Check out this review by The Barbershop Duet!



We’ve been at it for years.  Trying to develop the perfect Shave Soap.  It’s not as easy as it sounds - you can put super effective oils and exotic ingredients in your product, and then it’s not affordable.  You can try to make an affordable product, but then it’s not a good performer.  The market has had a huge gap between affordability and performance.  Until now.

We set out to develop a Shave Soap that was among the best in the industry (with super easy blade glides, highly nourishing and moisturizing, and that great post-shave feel) but using ingredients that are affordable.  And, after years of work, we finally did it!

If you’ve never used a Shave Soap before, you will be amazed how much better they are than store bought shaving creams.  They last eons longer than those crazy expensive cans and they aren’t loaded up with chemicals and unpronounceable ingredients.  If you are a Shave Soap pro, well we are confident you will find the Lockhart’s Shave Soap among the best in class in the artisan industry, but at consumer friendly pricing. 

PRO TIP:
Take a small amount of shave soap out of the jar and add it to a small shaving mug or bowl. Using a shaving brush, lather the soap for at least 30 seconds. The longer you lather the soap the thicker it will become! Continue lathering until achieving the lather desired.

So what's in it you ask?

Stearic Acid, Coconut Oil, Distilled Water, Castor Oil, Potassium Hydroxide, Shea Butter, Glycerin, Cocoa Butter, Fragrance, Buttermilk, Sodium Lactate, Sodium Hydroxide, Mango Butter, Lanolin, Avocado Oil, Vitamin E

Why do we use these ingredients:

  • VITAMIN E and AVOCADO OIL: YUMMY snacks for your face because your skin is always hungry
  • GLYCERIN:  draws moisture to the skin and makes your blade effortlessly
    glide over your face. We love glycerin – the work horse of a great shaving
    soap.
  • SODIUM LACTATE: Extra nourishing and a gentle preservative
  • SHEA BUTTER: Helps skin retain moisture, which in turn makes it soft, smooth, and kissable. Shea is loaded with antioxidants and anti-inflammatory agents (important stuff to help fight aging)
  • CASTOR OIL: Helps reduce water loss through the outer layer of the skin AND, importantly, Castor Oil makes your shaving soap whip up like thick gooey whipped cream!
  • BUTTERMILK: Exfoliates the upper damaged layer of the skin to reveal healthy, even-toned skin.
  • MANGO BUTTER: Contains lots of Vitamin A, an antioxidant that stimulates the skin's natural renewal process.
  • COCOA BUTTER: Contains fats that form a protective barrier over the skin to hold in moisture.
  • DISTILLED WATER: Has any and all of the impurities removed.
  • LANOLIN: Hydrates your face for a very long time by penetrating deep into its layers, giving you a magnificent post-shave feel.
  • STEARIC ACID: Just a fancy form of palm oil that is used, along with Coconut Oil, as the base for a truly luxurious shaving soap. All of our oils are sustainable. (Because a great shave is important, and so is protecting our environment.)
  • Most importantly, our shave soap has NO nasty chemicals, nothing you can't pronounce. Just wonderful ingredients that whip up to give you the most magnificent shaving soap that you have ever used!

products.title: The Edgar Allen Poe bundle
products.body_html:
TWO TALES. TWO STYLES. ONE DARK LEGACY.

Step into the world of Edgar Allan Poe with Nevermore and Phantasm, two hair styling products created by Lockhart’s and ModernManTV.

This bundle includes:

  • Nevermore Matte Paste - 3.4 oz.

  • Phantasm Sculpting Cream - 3.4 oz.

Nevermore takes its name from the haunting refrain of Poe’s The Raven. Its firm-to-strong hold, matte finish, and high texture make it a choice for styles with volume and definition. Its fragrance opens with lemon verbena, pineapple, and bergamot, settling into florals, woods, amber, and vanilla.

Phantasm draws its name from Poe’s The Black Cat, where the narrator cannot escape “the phantasm of the cat.” This sculpting cream offers firm-to-strong, flexible hold with a natural, low-shine finish. Its fragrance blends citrus and spice with leather, tobacco, woods, and vanilla.

Both formulas are water-based and water-soluble, giving you two ways to style with an easier washout. Whether you prefer the textured finish of Nevermore or the natural look of Phantasm, this collection brings a little of Poe’s dark imagination to your daily routine.

Two classics of the macabre. Two products made to perform.

products.title: Lockhart's Sex Machine Shave Soap
products.body_html:
4 ounces (113g)

Sex Machine Scent

  • Smells like:
    amber. saffron. patchouli. cedar. sandalwood. musk. the intoxicating aroma hanging in the air of a sultry burlesque show.

We love shaving here at Lockhart’s.  It’s the one self-care experience that men get to own as their own.  

We’ve been at it for years here at Lockhart's Authentic.  Trying to develop the perfect Shave Soap.  It’s not as easy as it sounds - you can put super effective oils and exotic ingredients in your product, and then it’s not affordable.  You can try to make an affordable product, but then it’s not a good performer.  The market has had a huge gap between affordability and performance.  Until now.

We set out to develop a Shave Soap that was among the best in the industry (with super easy blade glides, highly nourishing and moisturizing, and that great post-shave feel) but using ingredients that are affordable.  And, after years of work, we finally did it!

If you’ve never used a Shave Soap before, you will be amazed how much better they are than store bought shaving creams.  They last eons longer than those crazy expensive cans and they aren’t loaded up with chemicals and unpronounceable ingredients.  If you are a Shave Soap pro, well we are confident you will find the Lockhart’s Shave Soap among the best in class in the artisan industry, but at consumer friendly pricing.

PRO TIP:
Take a small amount of shave soap out of the jar and add it to a small shaving mug or bowl. Using a shaving brush, lather the soap for at least 30 seconds. The longer you lather the soap the thicker it will become! Continue lathering until achieving the lather desired.

So what's in it you ask?

Stearic Acid, Coconut Oil, Distilled Water, Castor Oil, Potassium Hydroxide, Shea Butter, Glycerin, Cocoa Butter, Fragrance, Buttermilk, Sodium Lactate, Sodium Hydroxide, Mango Butter, Lanolin, Avocado Oil, Vitamin E

Why do we use these ingredients:

  • VITAMIN E and AVOCADO OIL: YUMMY snacks for your face because your skin is always hungry
  • GLYCERIN:  draws moisture to the skin and makes your blade effortlessly
    glide over your face. We love glycerin – the work horse of a great shaving
    soap.
  • SODIUM LACTATE: Extra nourishing and a gentle preservative
  • SHEA BUTTER: Helps skin retain moisture, which in turn makes it soft, smooth, and kissable. Shea is loaded with antioxidants and anti-inflammatory agents (important stuff to help fight aging)
  • CASTOR OIL: Helps reduce water loss through the outer layer of the skin AND, importantly, Castor Oil makes your shaving soap whip up like thick gooey whipped cream!
  • BUTTERMILK: Exfoliates the upper damaged layer of the skin to reveal healthy, even-toned skin.
  • MANGO BUTTER: Contains lots of Vitamin A, an antioxidant that stimulates the skin's natural renewal process.
  • COCOA BUTTER: Contains fats that form a protective barrier over the skin to hold in moisture.
  • DISTILLED WATER: Has any and all of the impurities removed.
  • LANOLIN: Hydrates your face for a very long time by penetrating deep into its layers, giving you a magnificent post-shave feel.
  • STEARIC ACID: Just a fancy form of palm oil that is used, along with Coconut Oil, as the base for a truly luxurious shaving soap. All of our oils are sustainable. (Because a great shave is important, and so is protecting our environment.)
  • Most importantly, our shave soap has NO nasty chemicals, nothing you can't pronounce. Just wonderful ingredients that whip up to give you the most magnificent shaving soap that you have ever used!

Due to the alcohol base of this fragrance, this product can ONLY BE SHIPPED IN THE CONTINENTAL UNITED STATES. International orders will be canceled and refunded.All Lockhart's EDP Fragrances are bottled in glass bottles with a fine mist sprayer.

The opening scene hits fast.

A flash of grapefruit. A crack of black pepper. Something moves just outside the frame.

Thriller is our fragrance interpretation of the movies built around suspense, danger, pursuit, and the feeling that something is about to happen.

It starts bright and energetic with white grapefruit, bergamot, and pepper before moving into aromatic herbs and spice. As it develops, smooth woods, vetiver, musk, and Iso E Super begin to take over, leaving behind a darker, more elusive trail.

Fresh enough to grab your attention immediately.

Mysterious enough to keep you wondering what happens next.

Bergamot

Red Thyme

5 Thrillers to watch ASAP:

  • Se7en (1995)
  • The Silence of the Lambs (1991)
  • Blue Velvet (1986)

How did Thriller films inspire this fragrance? 

Why did Thriller films inspire this fragrance?

We wanted the fragrance itself to have movement.

Bright grapefruit and pepper create an immediate opening before aromatic sage, thyme, and geranium begin changing the direction. The deeper it gets into the dry-down, the smoother and darker the fragrance becomes.

Think of it like a movie that starts at full speed and refuses to tell you exactly where it's taking you.

The marquee says adults only. That should probably tell you enough.

XXX is our fragrance interpretation of the sexy, provocative, over-the-top world of sexploitation cinema and the adult theaters, red velvet rooms, questionable motels, and neon-lit nights surrounding it.

The opening is hot and aromatic: bergamot, pink pepper, and saffron. Lavender and clove move into leather and patchouli before the fragrance settles into oakwood, cedar, vetiver, Ambroxan, musk, and smooth woods.

It's sexy, but it isn't polished.

Sandalwood
Vetiver
Iso E Super
Amber
Musk

What is Giallo?

What is Giallo?

Giallo is a style of Italian thriller and horror cinema that exploded in popularity during the 1960s and 1970s. The films became known for vivid color, stylish cinematography, elaborate murder mysteries, masked or black-gloved killers, pulpy violence, and unforgettable soundtracks.

The word giallo literally means “yellow” in Italian, a reference to the yellow-covered mystery novels that helped inspire the genre.

5 Giallos to watch ASAP:

  • Phenomena (1985)
  • Opera (1987)
  • Deep Red (1975)
  • Tenebrae (1982)
  • The Bird with the Crystal Plumage (1970)

Why does the fragrance smell this way?

We wanted Giallo to feel unmistakably Italian without simply smelling old-fashioned. Bright bergamot, grapefruit, and yuzu give it that classic Mediterranean freshness, while smooth woods, musk, Hedione, and Iso E Super bring the fragrance into the present.

Clean tailoring on the surface.

Something dangerous underneath.

Clay products are all over the market and most of them miss the mark. Some leave your hair bone dry and unhealthy. Others are greasy, heavy, or impossible to work through. Holds range from stiff and crunchy to weak and wispy.

Lockhart’s Matte Clay sits right in the middle where great styling actually happens. It gives honest medium hold that moves naturally, stays touchable, and keeps its shape. HOW IT FEELS

More Than a Machine

T-800 EDP is an officially licensed Terminator 2: Judgment Day fragrance inspired by the transformation at the heart of the film.

The T-800 begins as a machine. Cold. Precise. Built to follow orders.

But as the story continues, something changes. He becomes John Connor’s protector, companion, and almost a father figure. What begins as programming slowly becomes loyalty, sacrifice, and something remarkably close to humanity.

This fragrance was built to follow that same path.

It opens with bright bergamot, crisp grapefruit, green mandarin, and cool aldehydes. The first impression is clean, controlled, and sharply focused.

As it develops, lavender, violet leaf, orange blossom, and soft white florals bring warmth to the center of the fragrance. The cold exterior begins to soften, revealing something calmer and more human underneath.

The drydown settles into Timbersilk, sandalwood, cedar, patchouli, amber woods, and clean musk. Smooth, warm, and dependable, the base has the quiet strength of a protector who will not stop until the mission is complete.

T-800 EDP is not meant to smell like smoke, gasoline, or machinery.

It tells the story of a machine that learned why people cry.

A Real Fragrance Built to Be Worn

This is not just a bottle for the shelf.

T-800 EDP is a full-size Eau de Parfum created for regular wear. It balances fresh citrus, aromatic lavender, soft florals, warm woods, and transparent amber to create a masculine fragrance that feels modern, clean, and approachable.

The opening is cool and precise.

The heart becomes softer and warmer.

The base is strong, comforting, and long-lasting.

It captures the emotional contrast that makes Terminator 2 more than an action movie. Strength without cruelty. Power with purpose. A machine becoming a protector.

T-800 EDP is joining the Lab Leaks fragrance lineup in limited numbers.

What Is the T-800?

The T-800 is the legendary cybernetic organism from Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Built as an infiltration unit, it combines living tissue with a metal endoskeleton.

In the film, the T-800 is reprogrammed and sent back through time to protect John Connor.

What begins as a mission becomes something deeper.

The T-800 learns human behavior, develops a bond with John, and becomes the steady father figure the boy never had. By the end, he understands the value of human life and chooses to sacrifice himself to protect it.

T-800 EDP translates that journey into fragrance.

Cool at first. Warmer with time. Powerful from beginning to end.

products.title: Light Hold Pomade Wash Out System
products.body_html:
This bundle combines our Light Hold Pomade with the perfect system for breaking down and removing oil based buildup without stripping the hair dry.

What's Included

  • Light Hold Oil Based Pomade

  • Groom Cream

  • Goon Wash Degreasing Shampoo

How To Use It

Step 1: Style with Light Hold

Apply Light Hold Pomade to dry hair for classic slick styles, natural control, clean shine, and lightweight hold with flexibility.

Step 2: Break Down the Pomade with Groom Cream

Before showering, apply Groom Cream directly into dry hair and work it through evenly.

The Groom Cream helps soften and loosen the oil based pomade buildup so it washes out much more effectively.

For heavier buildup or multiple days of use, allow the Groom Cream to sit in the hair for several minutes before rinsing.

Step 3: Wash with Goon Wash

Rinse lightly, then shampoo with Goon Wash to remove the broken-down pomade from the hair.

If buildup is especially thick, a second round of Groom Cream followed by another wash with Goon Wash may be necessary for a full cleanout.

Pro Tip

You can also apply a light “top coat” of Groom Cream throughout the day over your styled hair. As it sits, it gradually breaks down the oil based pomade, allowing Goon Wash to remove it much more easily later that night.

products.title: Heavy Hold Pomade Wash Out System
products.body_html:
This bundle combines our legendary Heavy Hold Pomade with the exact products needed to properly break down and remove stubborn oil based buildup from the hair.

What's Included

  • Heavy Hold Oil Based Pomade

  • Groom Cream

  • Goon Wash Degreasing Shampoo

How To Use It

Step 1: Style with Heavy Hold

Apply Heavy Hold Pomade to dry hair for extreme control, strong hold, texture, and all-day slick styles that stay locked in place.

Step 2: Break Down the Buildup with Groom Cream

Before showering, apply Groom Cream directly into dry hair and work it through thoroughly.

The Groom Cream helps soften and break apart the heavy oil and wax buildup so it can be removed much more effectively during washing.

For especially thick buildup, allow the Groom Cream to sit in the hair for several minutes before rinsing.

Step 3: Wash with Goon Wash

Rinse lightly, then shampoo with Goon Wash to fully remove the broken-down pomade from the hair.

If you’re using large amounts of Heavy Hold or have several days of buildup, a second round of Groom Cream followed by another wash with Goon Wash may be necessary for a complete cleanout.

Pro Tip

You can also apply a light “top coat” of Groom Cream throughout the day over your styled hair. As it sits, it gradually softens the oil based pomade buildup, making it much easier for Goon Wash to remove at the end of the night.

products.title: Lockhart's Shave Brushes - Custom Made in Italy
products.body_html:
We partnered with Zenith brush company of Italy, the #1 premium shave brush manufacturer in the world, to create one of the best shave brushes you can buy.  Anywhere.  

24mm-26mm size shave brushes are considered the gold standard in the industry - the absolute perfect size for face shaving.  

These custom designed shave brushes come in either a standard custom resin handle or a handcrafted mixed resin handle.  The standard handle one measures 24mm (tuft diameter) x 57mm (height) and the handcrafted mixed resin handle measures 26mm (tuft diameter) x 57mm (height).  

They both utilize the highest quality Zenith premium boar hair for the best lathering experience available in wet shaving.  We have tried and tested them all for you: synthetic, badger hair, horse hair, and boar hair.

After one to two dozen uses (allowing the bristles soften up a bit) boar brushes provide the richest lathering experience possible in wet shaving.  And, we wanted to make sure our customers got the richest lathering and best shaving experience available.

The custom handcrafted resin handles are described like this from our Italian partner: “The handcrafted handles are made using a very long and complex process. In fact, 85% of the process is done by hand, with only the turning work being mechanized. This is why it is so costly, and we reserve it for our top-of-the-line shaving brushes.”  The best part, no two handcrafted handles are the same.  Because they are handcrafted and the resin colors are mixed for each one individually, every brush is unique. 

Both brushes perform the same, but for those discerning customers looking for a more custom experience, the custom handcrafted handles are truly works of art, handcrafted by generations of Italian brush craftsmen.  

Please note that the boar in the standard resin handle is unbleached and the hair on the handcrafted resin handle is bleached.  These are for cosmetic reasons only and do not affect the quality of the premium Zenith boar hair experience we are offering.

products.title: Dauntless - Texture Powder
products.body_html:
The Dauntless Texture Powder has been completely rebuilt from the ground up—engineered to deliver instant texture, volume, oil control, and flexible hold without weighing hair down.

This next-level men’s styling powder is layered with performance-driven ingredients, each serving a precise purpose for effortless, all-day style.

How It Works

We start with a powerful clay base of Bentonite Clay and Kaolin Clay, delivering immediate grip, lift, and a dry matte finish. These clays create the foundation for natural-looking volume and separation.

Next, a smooth blend of Activated Charcoal and Arrowroot Powder refreshes the hair and absorbs excess oil, acting like a dry shampoo to eliminate second-day greasiness while adding even more texture.

To enhance thickness and fullness, Silica Powder plumps and volumizes the hair shaft. To prevent over-drying, Aloe Extract balances the formula and keeps hair comfortable and manageable.

Finally, VP/VA Copolymer locks everything together, providing a variable-to-medium hold that keeps your style in place while remaining reworkable throughout the day.

Secret Styling Method (Pro Tip)

Activate the powder’s hidden styling mode by placing a small amount into your hands, adding a few drops of water, and mixing until it forms a light, mud-like consistency. Apply to damp hair, then blow-dry for added control, texture, and hold—perfect for precision styling.

Scent

Lightly scented with our signature “Fearless” cologne fragrance, designed only to neutralize the natural scent of raw ingredients. Clean, subtle, and nearly undetectable once applied.

Directions

Blow-dry hair until fully dry. Lightly tap the powder directly onto the roots, then work it through with your fingers to activate texture and volume.
Alternatively, dispense the powder into your hands first and apply evenly throughout the hair.

Use sparingly for natural lift or apply more generously for bold volume and stronger texture. Easily reworkable throughout the day.

products.title: Lockhart's × Barrister & Mann: Terror Again Shave Soap
products.body_html:
Lockhart's × Barrister & Mann: Terror Again Shave Soap

 

Now colder than ever!

There is a place. A place that hungers for the warmth of living things, that consumes all who come near. A bitter, empty wasteland, a yawning chasm at the top of the world.

Such places are not meant for men.

The HMS Terror, along with all 129 souls it carried, was lost to the Arctic in 1848, consumed by the endless, empty hunger of the ice. A veteran of the War of 1812 and retrofitted for Arctic exploration, the Terror and its sister ship the HMS Erebus were swallowed by the frigid waters, their crews left to make their way for 600 miles in an attempt to escape the same fate.

But the creeping, bone-shattering cold of the Arctic does not abide weakness. Nor does it have any regard for strength of spirit and stoutness of character. It knows only hunger, and devours without restraint. None survived.

Inspired by the grisly legend of the Terror and the Erebus, our Terror shaving soap gives new meaning to bitter cold. We blended frankincense (the smell of ship’s timbers) with the very essence of cold water to bring to mind the empty wastes of the Arctic Circle, and have incorporated our custom blend of cooling agents to bring an insidious, endless chill to the experience. Tearless and stingless, unlike its mentholated cousin Arctique, Terror is a ghastly revelation, a glimpse into abyss.

Heaven help us if it ever glimpses back.

Check out this review below by The Barbershop Duet!

The Scent

Terror smells like the Arctic itself:

  • Top Notes: Sea spray, crushed ice, cold ozone 
  • Mid Notes: Frankincense, weathered oak timber, salted ocean air
  • Bottom Notes: Cocoa butter warmth, resin, faint smoke

The Freeze

Our custom menthol blend creates a spreading cold that deepens for 10-15 minutes.

Performance

The most intense cooling experience you'll ever feel. Built on Barrister & Mann's legendary Omnibus base, enriched with coconut milk, avocado oil, kokum and cupuaçu butters, and goat milk, the lather builds dense and slick, cushioning the blade while keeping that polar chill alive through every pass.

Post-shave, the marshmallow root and slippery elm extracts soothe the skin as it thaws from its icy sensation.

Who This Is For

  • Menthol enthusiasts who think other products are "too mild"
  • Hot climate shavers who need serious cooling relief
  • Wet shavers who want a unique, unforgettable shaving experience
  • Anyone brave enough to handle the coldest shave soap on the market

How to Use

  1. Soak your brush and load Terror generously — this soap likes water.
  2. Build a dense, creamy lather in a bowl or directly on the face.
  3. Shave as normal, feeling the cold begin to creep in.
  4. Finish with cool water — leave your face slightly damp.
  5. Apply Terror Aftershave
  6. Brace yourself – the cold builds over 2-3 minutes
  7. Enjoy 10-15 minutes of arctic intensity

Pro Tip: The cooling agents activate with moisture. Apply to damp skin for maximum frost. 

Warning: Seriously cold. Start with less product if you're new to high-menthol shave soaps. Keep away from eyes.

The Collaboration

Lockhart's Authentic × Barrister & Mann brings together two artisan grooming brands obsessed with pushing boundaries.

Together: The coldest, most sophisticated shaving experience available.

MG Pomaden The Barber: Strong Hold

Product information "MG Pomaden The Barber: Strong Hold"

HOLD: firm, SHINE: natural, subtle

FRAGRANCE: Pleasant scent of fresh rolling tobacco, woody, spicy

-New formula for a strong hold
-Much easier to work in than other products of this hardness level. Therefore also suitable for
beginners
-Easier to wash out
-Reduction of ingredients to the bare essentials
-Improved Haircare by use of medical Vaseline, natural beeswax and lanolin, castor oil and cedar and lemon essential oils.

Ingredients: Cera Alba, Lanolin, Petrolatum, Talc, Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Juniperus
Verginiana Wood Oil, Citrus Lemon Peel Oil, Parfum: Citral, Coumarin, Eugenol, Limonene,
Linalool

products.title: MG Pomaden Granny's Lemon Grove: Medium Hold
products.body_html:
MG Pomaden Granny's Lemon Grove: Medium Hold

Product information "MG Pomaden Granny's Lemon Grove: Medium Hold"

HOLD: medium, SHINE: high

Fragrance: fresh lemon, tart, woody

The Granny's Lemon Grove medium-strength pomade impresses with its easy application, good hold and wonderful tart, lemony fragrance.

The high-quality ingredients not only style the hair, but also care for it.

Ingredients: Petrolatum, Lanolin, Cera Alba, Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Cedrus Atlantica Bark Oil, Citrus Limon Peel/ Fruit Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Limnanthes Alba Seed Oil, Squalane, Cymbopogon Flexuosus Oil, PARFUM: Linalool, Limonene, Citronellol, Coumarin, Eugenol, Geraniol, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, Citral
